issues.body:
Add a sign-up form under the footer: a visitor leaves an email address and we keep it, so the founder can write to everyone when the site changes.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.
